description: Draft, schedule, and publish your business social media from ChatGPT. Mavlow brings your brand voice, content calendar, and approval queue into chat for Instagram, TikTok, and X. Set up a new workspace by sharing your website or a short business description so Mavlow can learn your brand and start a first draft. Check calendar gaps, send captions with images or video straight to your Queue, batch-schedule weeks of posts in your workspace timezone, update drafts, approve scheduled slots, and publish without leaving chat. To connect Instagram or X, Mavlow gives you a secure browser link.

defaultPrompt: Use Mavlow to draft next week's Instagram posts in our brand voice.
Show my Mavlow social schedule for the next month.
Schedule three Instagram posts for Tuesday and Friday at 10am in Mavlow.
